name: coordkit
description: Claude Code orchestration: a shared bus + ledger that warns about concurrent edits, with an opt-in hard anti-clobber guard built in (coordkit), and skill auto-activation with agents and dev-docs (skillkit). coordguard is a deprecated tombstone — its guard now ships inside coordkit.

plugins.name: skillkit
plugins.description: Skill auto-activation: a UserPromptSubmit hook matches prompts against layered skill-rules.json files (global ~/.claude/skills + per-project) and injects 'use this skill' reminders. Ships 10 specialized agents, /dev-docs context-persistence commands, and the skill-developer meta-skill. Suggest-only — never blocks.

plugins.name: coordkit
plugins.description: Same-machine coordination bus + cross-instance ledger, plus an opt-in hard anti-clobber guard (merged in from coordguard). WARN-only by default: tracks who else is live in a repo and which files they touch, and surfaces it — never blocks a tool call. Run /guard on to enable guard mode, which additionally denies a Write/Edit when the target file changed on disk since this session last read it — the signature of a sibling instance's edit.

plugins.name: coordguard
plugins.description: DEPRECATED — as of coordkit 3.0.0 this plugin's anti-clobber guard was merged into coordkit as an opt-in guard mode. Installing this version gets you no enforcement: it only prints a one-time deprecation notice pointing at /guard on in coordkit. Nothing to install here for functionality — uninstall it once you've switched.
